title: Treaty of Aranjuez (1752)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of Aranjuez (1752)", at revision 1368310261, opens: "The Treaty of Aranjuez (1752) was signed on 14 June, 1752, between Austria, Spain and the Kingdom of Sardinia." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4890548, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "which recognizes Austrian and Spanish interests in Italy". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
